entities.summary: Adam Robert Wilk is an American former professional baseball pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Detroit Tigers, Los Angeles of Anaheim, New York Mets, and Minnesota Twins, and in the KBO League for the NC Dinos.
